Rashi on Menachot 87b:1:1.hebrew: מחוק שבו היה מודד חביתי כ"ג - לפי שיש לו לחלק בשני חצאי עשרון, ואם היה גדוש, כשהיה מטלטלו לחצותו היה מתפזר על גבי קרקע:
Rashi on Menachot 87b:1:1.english: The level [tool] with which he would measure the griddle-cakes of the High Priest - Because he had to divide it into two half-tenths, and if it were heaped, when he would move it in order to divide it, it would scatter onto the ground.

Rashi on Menachot 87b:12:1.hebrew: מדאמר ר"מ עשרון שבו מודד לחביתי כ"ג מחוק, חצי עשרון נמי מחוק הוה - דהא הוה נמי לחביתי כ"ג:
Rashi on Menachot 87b:12:1.english: Since Rabbi Meir said that the tenth-ephah with which one measures for the High Priest's griddle-cakes is level, the half-tenth [measure] is likewise level - since that [vessel] was also used for the High Priest's griddle-cakes.

Rashi on Menachot 87b:12:2.hebrew: ומדר"מ - דאמר שניהם מחוק היו, אותו עשרון של כ"ג והחצי עשרון נמי. לרבנן נמי לא היה בו אלא עשרון אחד, ובו היה מודד לחביתי כ"ג, ה"נ דמחוק היה זה וזה, דלדברי הכל של כ"ג מחוק היה, דהכי פליגי בברייתא רבי מאיר ורבנן: מחוק שבו היה מודד לחביתי כ"ג, וחכמים אומרי' לא היה בו אלא עשרון אחד מחוק:
Rashi on Menachot 87b:12:2.english: And from Rabbi Meir - That is, [Rav Chisda] said: both were level-scraped - that tenth-vessel of the Kohen Gadol, and the half-tenth as well. According to the Rabbis too, there was only one vessel there, a tenth, with which he would measure for the Kohen Gadol's griddle-cakes; so too here, both this one and that one were level-scraped, for according to everyone the Kohen Gadol's vessel was level-scraped. For this is how Rabbi Meir and the Rabbis disagree in the beraita: [Rabbi Meir holds] it was the level-scraped vessel with which he would measure for the Kohen Gadol's griddle-cakes, while the Sages say there was only one level-scraped tenth-vessel there.

Rashi on Menachot 87b:14:1.hebrew: חביתי כ"ג - אותן שנים עשר חלות שעושה, ששה בבקר וששה בערב:
Rashi on Menachot 87b:14:1.english: The griddle-cakes of the High Priest - Those twelve loaves that he makes, six in the morning and six in the evening.

Rashi on Menachot 87b:14:2.hebrew: במה מחלקן - לחלות, ביד או בכלי? ישער בידו, או יחלקם בכלי:
Rashi on Menachot 87b:14:2.english: With what does he divide them - Into loaves: by hand or with a vessel? He would estimate [the amount] with his hand, or divide them using a vessel.

Rashi on Menachot 87b:14:3.english: Would he bring in scales? - If it would be necessary to bring weights [to weigh out the dough for the loaves].

Rashi on Menachot 87b:16:1.hebrew: שלחן מהו שיקדש קמצים בגודש שלו - כגון שאם הניח קומץ של מנחה או (של) לבונה בלא בזיכין, שהיה לו לקדשו בכלי, והניחן על השולחן שבו לחם, ולא קידשו בכלי אחר, והיינו "בגודש שלו" שלא הניחו בבזיכין אלא למעלה בין לחם ללחם, שהכל היה בגודש שלא הניחן בתוך כלי. ענין אחר: "בגודש שלו", דשולחן לא היה לו בית קיבול כלל למעלה, וכל מה שמניחין עליו הוי כמו שמונח בגודש, כך שמעתי:
Rashi on Menachot 87b:16:1.english: Table - does it sanctify the handfuls in its heap? - For example, if one placed the handful of a meal-offering, or [the handful] of frankincense, without [putting it in] the dishes - when he was required to sanctify it in a vessel - and instead placed them on the table on which the bread lay, without sanctifying it in another vessel: that is what is meant by "in its heap," that he did not place it in the dishes but above, between one loaf and the next, so that it was entirely within the heap, not placed inside a vessel. Another interpretation of "in its heap": that the table had no receptacle at all on its top, and whatever is placed upon it is as though it were placed in the heap - so have I heard.

Rashi on Menachot 87b:16:2.english: That which is not fit for it: Such as a handful [of flour] and frankincense without [service] bowls.

Rashi on Menachot 87b:3:1.english: From the vav of the word ve'issaron he derives it.

Rashi on Menachot 87b:5:1.hebrew: מנקודו - שאותו נקוד שעליו אתי למעט, דכל נקודה אתי למעוטי:
Rashi on Menachot 87b:5:1.english: From its dot: That is, the dot that is over it comes to exclude something, for every dot [in the Torah] comes to exclude.

Rashi on Menachot 87b:6:1.hebrew: שבו היה מודד חביתי כ"ג - השתא משמע שמודד חצי עשרון בביתו ומביא, והיינו דקא פריך מודד:
Rashi on Menachot 87b:6:1.english: With it he would measure the griddle-cakes of the High Priest - Now this implies that he measures a half-tenth [of an ephah] at his home and brings it, and this is [the word] that the Gemara challenges: "measure"?

Rashi on Menachot 87b:8:1.hebrew: מחלק - שהיה מביאו מביתו שלם לעזרה, ואח"כ חוצהו בחצי העשרון:
Rashi on Menachot 87b:8:1.english: He divides [it]: For he would bring it whole from his home to the Temple courtyard, and afterward divide it by half-tenths.

Tosafot on Menachot 87b:14:1.hebrew: במה מחלקה לחלות - פירש בקונטרס שמחלקה לעיסה, וא"א לומר כך, דהא אמרינן לקמן (מנחות דף פח:) דרביעית נמשחה שבו היה מודד לחביתי כ"ג רביעית שמן לכל חלה וחלה, וקודם לישה צריך לבלול כשהוא סלת. ומכל מקום לא אפשר לעשות בו טורטני, דמשקולת ומאזנים סימן קללה בסלת כמו בעיסה, ומדה קטנה כל כך של א' משנים עשר בעשרון לא רצו לתקן, ואפשר דקטנה כל כך גם היא אינה סימן ברכה:
Tosafot on Menachot 87b:14:1.english: With what does he divide it into loaves? - Rashi explained that he divides it into dough [i.e., the division into the twelve loaves is done to the kneaded dough itself]. But it is impossible to say so, for we say further on (Menachot 88b) that the quarter-log [of oil] that was anointed was that with which he would measure the oil for the High Priest's griddle-cakes - a quarter-log of oil for each and every loaf - and this [measuring] must take place before the kneading, while it is still fine flour that needs to be mixed together [with the oil]. In any event, it is not possible to divide it precisely by weight, for a scale and balance are a sign of a curse when used with flour just as with dough. And they did not want to establish a measure as small as one-twelfth of a tenth [of an ephah, i.e., the portion per loaf]. And it is possible that something so small a measure is also not a sign of blessing.

Tosafot on Menachot 87b:7:1.hebrew: מודד ורמינהו חביתי כהן גדול כו' - מהא דקאמר ר"מ: ומחוק שבו מודד לחביתי כ"ג, לא בעי לאקשויי, דסלקא דעתך שפעמים מודד בזה ופעמים בזה:
Tosafot on Menachot 87b:7:1.english: Does he measure? But we raise a contradiction: the High Priest's griddle-cakes, etc. - There is no need to raise a difficulty from that which Rabbi Meir said [in the mishna], 'and the leveled one is that with which he measures for the High Priest's griddle-cakes' [implying that it is the whole, level tenth-measure that is used] - for one might have said that sometimes he measures with this vessel and sometimes with that one, [so Rabbi Meir's two statements are not truly contradictory, and the Gemara therefore needed to bring the explicit teaching that the griddle-cakes are never brought in halves].
